summary: Solid test suite covering all three retention policies, error handling, and policy composition. Tests are well-organized into TDD cycles (CLI contract → parsing → individual policies → composition). Integration testing via act with exact-value assertions strengthens regression detection. Main gaps: edge cases like zero policy values, floating-point sizes, explicit comment/blank-line handling; fixture files not visible to verify they exist; some error conditions (--now parsing, size/date field validation) not explicitly tested. Workflow structure validation is thorough. Would likely catch most regressions but some boundary conditions could slip through.
